subject.title: fix(gradium): TTS rejects untrusted base URLs before sending API keys

question: Should Gradium TTS `baseUrl` become official-host-only on `https://api.gradium.ai`, even though the latest release documented it as an API origin override?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but the security improvement changes a shipped config behavior, so maintainer intent is needed to decide the compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Accept official-host-only
options.body: Land the fail-closed host restriction as a credential boundary and treat non-Gradium hosts as unsupported for this provider.

options.title: Add trusted-host escape hatch
options.body: Keep the secure default but require a separate, clearly risky opt-in path for operators who intentionally proxy Gradium.

options.title: Pause for provider direction
options.body: Hold or rework the PR if maintainers consider arbitrary `baseUrl` overrides part of the Gradium plugin contract.

recommendation.title: Accept official-host-only
recommendation.body: Land the fail-closed host restriction as a credential boundary and treat non-Gradium hosts as unsupported for this provider.

likelyOwner.reason: This user is tied to both the original Gradium integration merge and recent current-main Gradium file history.
